verdict.rationale: Brex explicitly markets AI-powered invoice entry, approval, and payment automation, procurement approval flows on vendor cards, and a Payments API to manage vendors and send ACH/wires/checks, covering bill upload → approval → payment. However, there's no detailed documentation of the actual bill-upload UI or approval-chain configuration mechanics, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the approval workflow's reliability. Missing for 10: concrete walkthrough or independent review of the bill-upload and multi-step approval routing UI, and evidence of configurable approval thresholds/roles.
